story-context.title: Point Entry Grid
story-context.design-philosophy:
"How did they ever do their job without this?"
Points entry should be seamless and fit the natural workflow of the day. Base points are auto-granted when attendance is marked present - staff only need to intervene for adjustments (bonus or deductions). This frees up teacher time to spend with students rather than on data entry.
story-context.summary: Add point tracking to the Room Roster page. Base 10 points are auto-granted per period when a student is marked present (attendance-driven). Teachers can add adjustments (+10, +5, 0, -5, -10, -15) with student_action, teacher_action dropdowns and notes. Today's Total column shows running day total with color coding based on % of expected by current period.

adjustment-points.example: - Halfway through: +5 "Finished assignment early, started next without prompting" - End of period: 0 "Got bored, head down, off-task, had to redirect"

entry-log.description: Visible to student/parent on student page
entry-log.fields: timestamp, period, teacher name, adjustment, student_action, notes

points-model.day-total-calculation:
Day Total = SUM(base_points for present periods) + SUM(adjustments)
Example at 5th period: - 5 periods present = 50 base points - 1 adjustment of -5 (off task in period 3) - Day Total = 50 + (-5) = 45 points - Expected = 50, so 45/50 = 90% (green/blue)

database-considerations.current-schema: CREATE TABLE daep_daily_points ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, placement_id UUID NOT NULL, date DATE NOT NULL, period TEXT NOT NULL, points_earned INT NOT NULL CHECK (points_earned >= 0 AND points_earned <= 10), student_action TEXT, teacher_action TEXT, notes TEXT, entered_by TEXT NOT NULL, approved_by TEXT, approval_status TEXT DEFAULT 'approved', public BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, UNIQUE(tenant_id, placement_id, date, period) );
